Subject: Client Transition: Orchestration Checklist & Owner Commitments

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP_v1.2.xlsx) that lays out milestone dates, primary owners, and escalation contacts for the Lumos rollout. Key asks on our side: review owners, confirm any internal approvals that will affect the acceptance window, and flag known blackout dates for November/December.

Proposed high-level timeline (subject to your feedback):
- Week 1 (Nov 15–21): Legal & SOW signoff (owner: Lumos procurement)
- Week 2–3 (Nov 22–Dec 5): Integration sprint 0 (owner: Redwood eng)
- Week 4–6 (Dec 6–26): Feature enablement & validation (owner: Lumos product)
- Week 7 (Jan 4): Cutover & acceptance (owner: Lumos ops + Redwood CS)

I've looped Neha (CS lead) and Monica (implementation PM) to coordinate the handoff cadence. Ben — please confirm whether we should lock in the reserved capacity for the initial integration weeks or keep on hosted with burst. Rishi — flag any potential SLA exceptions given the proposed cutover date.

Attachments: MAP_v1.2.xlsx (milestones/owners), SOW_draft_20261112.pdf (draft SOW)

Next steps: Elena to review owners and blackout dates by EOD Tuesday; Redwood to publish final MAP and schedule weekly 30-minute syncs.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear plan and the worksheet. A few notes after a quick pass:
- Owners: Product will own feature validation (I'll assign Priya as primary), Ops will own cutover but we need Redwood to cover runbook walkthroughs.
- Blackouts: Our finance year-end freeze is Dec 20–31 — that will affect testing windows.
- SOW: Legal has two redlines on data retention and audit logs; I'll upload comments to the doc (SOW_draft_comments.pdf).

We'll confirm owners and the blackout constraint by Tuesday 11/17. Also happy to take the weekly 30-minute sync — propose Tue 9:30am PST recurring.

Elena Park

Elena — appreciate the quick turn. I've updated the shared MAP with the changes I expect (sheet: v1.2 -> v1.3). Summary of updates I've made and actions assigned: 
- Owners: Priya (Lumos) added as Product validation lead; Monica (Redwood) listed as Implementation PM for sprint coordination.
- Testing windows: shifted validation phase to Dec 6–19 to avoid the Dec 20–31 freeze.
- Runbooks: Redwood will schedule two walkthroughs (Nov 29 and Dec 13) — Rishi, can you confirm availability?
- Legal redlines: Ben, please coordinate with Legal to respond to the data retention clause; I'll add a note in the SOW thread.

I've pasted the new acceptance criteria in the MAP notes tab and linked the doc here: https://redwood.gdrive/lumos/MAP_v1.2

Proposed cadence: Weekly Tue 9:30am PST sync starting 11/17. If that works for Lumos, I'll send the calendar invite and an agenda (runbook, milestones, blocker register).

Thanks — Neha
